title: Bizarre Material May Herald the Future of Computer Chips
summary: Unlike copper, newly described “nanoribbons” conduct electricity better as they shrink. If refined, the material could usher in a supercharged generation of microchips.
caption: An illustration of the newly described nanoribbons. Each one would be fractions of the width of a strand of human hair.

title: Europe’s Hera Mission Releases Close-Up Images of the Asteroid Hit by a NASA Spacecraft
summary: A European mission called Hera has just revealed the first close-up look at the aftermath of NASA’s audacious planetary defense test.
